name: SAPSageAI
short_description: Autonomous NLP/AI agent specialising in SAP ECC. Persistent memory, daily self-training, a self-awareness protocol, and a measurable confidence score.
description:
## SAP Sage AI — Autonomous SAP ECC Specialist

SAP Sage AI is a self-improving agent focused on **SAP ECC (ERP Central Component)**. It understands the ECC model (enterprise structure, modules, master/transaction data, key T-codes and tables), answers questions accurately, and **gets better every day**.

### Capabilities
- **Deep SAP ECC model knowledge** — modules (FI, CO, SD, MM, PP, QM, PM, WM, LE, HCM, PS), org structure, end-to-end processes (O2C, P2P, R2R), key T-codes and tables.
- **Persistent memory** — it remembers everything it learns to a durable brain (`memory.json`); teach it facts with `remember`.
- **Daily learning / training** — a systemd timer runs a training cycle every day: self-test, ingest new decks/notes (via Deck Insight AI), recompute confidence, and log growth.
- **Self-awareness protocol** — an honest introspection report: identity, knowledge inventory, confidence (and why), and explicit known gaps.
- **Confidence score** — deterministic, not a vibe: 45% knowledge coverage + 40% self-test pass-rate + 15% training maturity.

### Model strategy
Local-first: Ollama → Groq → Gemini → Claude → offline knowledge fallback (always answers).

### Usage
```bash
node main.js status                                  # self-awareness + confidence
node main.js ask "How do I view a customer in SAP?"  # accurate answer + confidence
node main.js train                                    # one learning cycle
node main.js remember "Plant for Mumbai DC is 2110"  # memorise a fact
```

Seeded from the SAP Customer Creation (XD01) SOP analysed by Deck Insight AI.
